meta.title: DS Super Bot · long-lived engineering team
meta.description: Multi-role engineering team for DSH: the lead agent acts as Tech Lead, decomposes the request into a task DAG and dispatches specialist subagents (pm / architect / backend-dev / frontend-dev / qa-engineer / browser-tester / reviewer), with a plan approval gate, bug track, maintenance loop and trusted-change gates; roles are charters injected at dispatch time (no agent presets, so the mode picker stays clean), per-role model routes live in the project superbot.config.json (editable in the Settings → Super Bot table; the project file wins), and the authoritative task board is the Agent Teams shared board. The UI is a per-session right-sidebar team panel: a layered workflow tree by default (Lead at the top-left, a trunk through spec → architecture → implementation → quality → acceptance → review with cards branching to the right), where each node shows role / actual model / task / state / elapsed / usage, click a node for its child session (graph or list), a native task-progress bar on top that counts the host's own task list without copying it, and the artifacts under tmp/superbot/ collapsed at the bottom; opened from the session-header icon and automatically on the first dispatch. The per-role model + effort table is in Settings → Super Bot. P2 adds the left console, header mini-faces and right-hand stage through official additive slots, without replacing host columns.
